data.title: VanEck CEO Warns Next US Financial Crisis Will Start In Washington, Urges Investors To Hold ‘Real Assets’ Like Gold and Bitcoin
data.description: VanEck is now focused on actively managed crypto funds, because most advisers struggled to choose between individual tokens, according to the CEO.
